caustica.options.rt.exposureMode.tooltip: How the ray-traced image is mapped to display brightness. Auto adapts to scene luminance; Manual uses the exposure value directly.
caustica.options.rt.manualEv.tooltip: Exposure compensation in stops. In Manual, this is the fixed exposure. In Auto, this biases the auto exposure brighter or darker.
caustica.options.rt.spp.tooltip: Path-tracing samples taken per pixel each frame. Higher is cleaner but more demanding.
caustica.options.rt.maxBounces.tooltip: Maximum number of secondary path-tracing bounces after the primary hit. Higher captures more indirect light but costs more.
caustica.options.rt.sunSize.tooltip: Angular radius of the sun and moon disk. Larger discs cast softer shadow penumbrae.
caustica.options.rt.entities.tooltip: Include entities and block entities in the ray-traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.particles.tooltip: Draw particles as camera-ray billboards inside the traced scene.
caustica.options.rt.glow.tooltip: Draw the vanilla Glowing-effect outline (through walls) around glowing entities.
caustica.options.rt.waterWaves.tooltip: Animate water-surface normals for moving wave highlights.
caustica.options.rt.tileJitter.tooltip: Quantize primary-ray jitter to 8x8 tiles so first-bounce rays stay coherent on non-SER GPUs (RDNA2/3, Arc, RADV). Undone downstream by the NRD pre-warp and TAAU reproject.
Store ReSTIR DI reservoirs at half resolution (1 per 2x2 tile). Saves ~60% reservoir VRAM on large flat surfaces.
caustica.options.rt.hdr.tooltip: Present in HDR (ST.2084/PQ) instead of SDR, when the display supports it. Takes effect after restarting the game.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPaperWhite.toolti: Absolute brightness (in nits) that SDR-equivalent scene brightness maps to on an HDR display.
caustica.options.rt.hdrPeak.tooltip: Absolute brightness (in nits) highlights roll off toward. Set to your display's peak HDR brightness.
caustica.options.rt.dlssQuality.tooltip: DLSS Ray Reconstruction quality mode. Lower-quality modes render fewer pixels and upscale more aggressively for higher framerates; higher-quality modes render more pixels for a sharper image. Only affects the image when DLSS Ray Reconstruction is enabled.
caustica.options.rt.debugView.tooltip: Visualize an intermediate ray-tracing buffer instead of the final image.
caustica.options.rt.debugOverlay.tooltip: Show live ray-tracing pipeline state in the top-left of the screen (active upscaler, denoise mode, frame counter, last DLSS-RR return code, per-stage timings). Useful when an image looks wrong.
caustica.options.rt.upscalerMode.tooltip: Which upscaler to use. Auto uses TAAU. Pick FSR2 for classic FidelityFX Super Resolution (pairs with the AMD FidelityFX denoise preset). Changes take effect immediately.
caustica.options.rt.denoiseMode.tooltip: Internal denoise. AMD FidelityFX: FFX shadow/refl + residual GI, forces FSR2 (no NRD). Auto: vendor pick (AMD→NRD). NRD: REBLUR only. FFX: same FFX stack without forcing FSR2. Hybrid: currently NRD-only (FFX prepass disabled). Off: raw grain.
caustica.options.rt.upscalerQuality.tool: Render-scale quality used by the active upscaler. Higher quality renders more source pixels; lower quality improves performance.
caustica.options.rt.giEnabled.tooltip: Enable ReSTIR GI reservoir reuse for secondary bounces. Off → cheap hemisphere ambient fallback.
caustica.options.rt.giMaxMTemporal.toolt: Cap on temporal-reuse count per GI reservoir. Higher = more history, lower temporal noise.
caustica.options.rt.giMaxMSpatial.toolti: Cap on spatial-reuse count per GI reservoir. Higher = more neighbours merged, lower noise but more cost.
caustica.options.rt.hybridEnabled.toolti: Skip RT for simple opaque bounces on rough surfaces with no nearby lights. Saves time on flat-shaded geometry.
caustica.options.rt.pairedReuseEnabled.t: ReSTIR PT Enhanced §3. Replaces the inline 9-tap spatial merge with a GPU compute pass that MIS-merges neighbours via 3 pre-baked pair tables. Off → legacy inline path.
caustica.options.rt.pairedReuseShufflePe: Frames between pair-table index rotations. Higher = more cache reuse, lower = more variance reduction.
caustica.options.rt.duplicationMapEnable: ReSTIR PT Enhanced §5. Compute a per-pixel V2-match ratio each frame and gate the temporal merge's M cap with it. Pixels in a homogeneous neighbourhood reuse more aggressively.
caustica.options.rt.footprintReconnectio: ReSTIR PT Enhanced §4. Tightens the temporal-merge motion threshold to avoid pulling history across large view-displacement boundaries.
caustica.options.rt.footprintMotionCapPx: Pixels whose screen-space motion exceeds this are rejected in the temporal merge. Default 25 px; lower = stricter.
caustica.options.rt.drsEnabled.tooltip: Auto-adjusts internal render resolution to keep frame time within the configured budget. Drops render scale under load, recovers when load eases.
caustica.options.rt.probeRecord.tooltip: Write per-frame pipeline lighting stats to rt-probe/probe.csv for data-driven diagnosis (analyse with scripts/analyze_probe.py). Costs disk space and a little frame time.
This starts writing a recording file (rt-probe/probe.csv) with per-frame lighting and pipeline stats. It can grow large over time and may cost some performance while recording.
